title: Avoiding singular matrices along a disk
promptMarkdown: Let $h:D^2\to M_{4\times2}(\mathbb R)$ be smooth and full rank on the boundary. Prove there is an arbitrarily small constant matrix $A$ such that $h+A$ is full rank on the entire disk, and the boundary homotopy $h+tA$ is full rank for $0\le t\le1$. Name the Sard dimension estimate and compactness step. Explain what changes for $3\times2$ matrices.
hintLadder: Compute the codimension of each deficient-rank stratum.
Build the incidence manifold with $A$ as a parameter.
Control the whole boundary homotopy with one positive-distance estimate.
